verdict.rationale: Carta's API documents law-firm use cases: law firms can fetch cap table data on behalf of a company, send new customers to Carta, and create draft issuers and draft option grants. That suggests outside counsel can update records programmatically rather than by emailing spreadsheets. However, nothing shows counsel working directly in the platform under dedicated law-firm roles or preparing documents there. missing for 10: in-platform law-firm role/permission model, document preparation workflows for counsel, evidence of counsel editing records in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
